title: Agentic Stream V0.1 Event Envelope
description: One accepted event, as an HTTP request body or one line of a replay JSONL file. V0 specified this only in prose; a machine contract is required because hand-authored traces are a first-class input to the golden and evaluation suites, and an unvalidated arrival_time silently corrupts age facts and the event horizon.

id.description: Globally unique. Reusing an id with a different payload is 409 event_id_reuse, never a silent duplicate-accept.

entity_type.description: Selects the active injected Situation Model. No active model for this type is 422.

entity_id.description: Opaque producer identifier. Restricted to a non-prose alphabet because it is carried into diagnostic snapshots.

type.description: Must map to a declared input of the active model.

event_time.description: RFC 3339, normalized to UTC nanoseconds. Must not be later than arrival_time.

arrival_time.description: Required in replay; forbidden in HTTP input and assigned by the server. Must be >= event_time, and replay records must be strictly increasing by recorded time. This field is the evaluation instant, so a fabricated value silently corrupts age facts, budgets, and wakes.

value.description: Number for value_type number, string for value_type string, omitted for value_type none. A number outside the input's declared min/max, or a string outside its enum, is well-formed but unusable: the event is persisted with admission_reason value_out_of_contract. Raw out-of-enum text is not copied into a reasoning-model snapshot.

unit.description: Required for number inputs, forbidden otherwise. Matched exactly; V0.1 performs no unit conversion.
